'''Commex's headquarters''' was the main office of the [[Commex]] corporation located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ulicia]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="GCPX" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|278|Ulicia}}</ref> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC note">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of "[[Priority: X]]," which include [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]]'s escape from [[Ulicia]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].capturing a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] named [[Naven Crel]] from</ref> the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Auditor-General|executive]] [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]] recovered a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] named [[Naven Crel]] from the headquarters.<ref name="GCPX" />
